_about: Reel n Creel spawn budgets (docs/HABITAT.md section 4). For each size class: max, the most of its fish within 64 blocks of a player; school, [min, max] fish per school. A school is placed whole or not at all: when less room is left than the school drawn, it is drawn down to the room left, never below min. A species' own school in data/creel/fish/<id>.json overrides the class's; solitary fish always come alone. A datapack may override this file; /reload applies it.
_salmon: salmon: the salmon run, our salmon and the steelhead whatever their size, counted together with vanilla's salmon, so the two kinds compete for one budget; vanilla's salmon are also held to 10 by data/creel/vanilla_caps.json, which counts ours
